entry.title: New: Bill 100 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, APPENDIX A, PART I, DEPARTMENT OF MANAGEMENT" The purpose of this bill is to add a new grant under the Department of Management entitled "Office of Justice Programs Bureau of Justice Assistance - Byrne Discretionary Community Project Funding/Byrne Discretionary Grant Program" in the amount of $180,000.
